_doc: The test runners the nightly orchestrator executes, in this order. See ORCHESTRATOR.md section 2.

runners.title: srcEnceladus forward-model tests
runners.note: also the standalone plume model's tests (srcEnceladus/standalone/tests), one row S_<module>.<Class>.<method> per test (U00_exporter is the registered aggregate of the four exporter modules); --validation-data-root is the Cassini validation data they read, --spice-path/--spice-kernels the CSPICE toolkit and kernels of S_spice_ground_tracks

runners.title: srcSEP 2013-04-11 event inputs: prepare_event.py check
runners.note: regenerates every checked-in input of the SEP--event-2013-04-11 tests (derived.json, observations.csv, event.event, event.in, event.nightly.in, event.args, the WSO asset, deck_summary.json, and the srcSEP3D 3-D decks and ephemerides of srcSEP3D/test/event_2013_04_11) from the raw archives and byte-compares them, so a change of the preparation script, its settings or the archives is caught; the Table tests themselves only read the checked-in files. About 5 s.

runners.title: srcSEP3D 2013-04-11 3-D additions: unit tests E3D01-E3D06
runners.note: standalone ASan/UBSan unit tests of the corotating frame, the focused-mover inertial terms, ephemeris interpolation, field-line tracing and the observer flux tube, the absorbing shock and the 1-D-equivalent tube-line source (srcSEP3D/test/event_2013_04_11/README.md, section 5); no AMPS build. About 30 s.

runners.title: srcSEP3D 2013-04-11 3-D additions: SPICE body-observer ephemeris E3D07
runners.note: the CSPICE-backed body-observer path (output/spice_ephemeris.cpp with -DSEP3D_WITH_SPICE, linked with the toolkit's cspice.a) reproduces the checked-in Earth table within the E3D07 tolerances (srcSEP3D/test/event_2013_04_11/README.md, section 5). test/stage1 links only the typed refusal, so this is the nightly's check of the SPICE path; no AMPS build. About 10 s.

runners.title: srcSEP: build and all test steps (tools/sep_test_orchestrator.py)
runners.note: 150 min: the runner took 101-104 min on 2026-11-23..26 and reached 120 min on 2026-11-27, when other jobs loaded passion (material-checkpoint-native 3464 s instead of about 2400 s)

runners.title: srcSEP3D: build and the regular test steps (--quick; long steps run in sep3d-long)
srcEarth test list (srcEarth/test/list)
prepare: ./amps -h 2>&1 | grep -q 'AMPS Earth' || { echo 'ERROR: ./amps is not an Earth build (make amps failed)'; exit 1; }
runners.note: --timeout 5400 is each entry's limit, except the SA QUICK entries (! runner: timeout 9000 in srcEarth/test/list); 540 min also fits three SA entries at their limit, so the runner always writes its report

runners.title: MakefileTest/Table tests (Makefile.test)
runners.note: the test list is 'make -s test_manifest'; add or remove tests in MakefileTest/Table

runners.title: srcSEP3D long validation steps (last: they get the rest of the night)
runners.note: not pitch-angle-library: that is the library's certification campaign (52 cases, ~37 CPU-hours, 14 documented FAILs of non-certified pairs); its nightly regression tier is the regular step pitch-angle-nightly of the sep3d runner

disabled.reason: the SWMF-coupled srcSEP path moves no particles yet (no prepopulation; with it every mover stops on its first step): the runs (20-35 min on 8 ranks each) check nothing until the srcSEP owner designs the coupled setup (turbulence datums, coefficient providers, prepopulation energies)
needs SWMF test19 and a 710 s SC+IH+OH time-accurate restart (hours) plus the coupled srcSEP path; its cnt=299 reference predates 2023
srcSEP3D needs a runtime amps.in since 2c06362b (2026-09-16) and has no ARMS DATAFILE background: to be re-specified by the srcSEP3D owner
needs Tecplot (tec360) for the background-plasma import and the data file 3d__mhd_3_n00045039-extracted.plt, neither on passion
